Name: Method
Description: Selects the sharpening technique to apply to the terrain or texture. Each method targets different aspects of the data for sharpening.

Flubs.Name: Edge
Flubs.Description: Sharpens the terrain or texture by enhancing edges, making transitions between features more pronounced.

Flubs.Name: Frequency
Flubs.Description: Sharpens by boosting high-frequency details, increasing the clarity of fine structures and textures.

Name: Amount
Description: The amount of sharpening to be applied to the structures. Higher values produce a stronger sharpening effect.
